activity_summary: At St Helen's you heard Master Thwaite name Lent and turn the sand-glass a second time. He said he would be brief, and Mistress Ansell did not believe him. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not speak to you. You came away with the fast named, and with nothing else from the pew.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the turns of the glass and said he had come to hear Lent named.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached Septuagesima, promised brevity, and turned the sand-glass a second time.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Timed the second turn of the glass, and noted that he had not said starch.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat three rows ahead in the Mayor's pew and did not speak.

facets.activity: Heard Master Thwaite name Lent and turn the glass a second time

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: And fourteenthly, brethren, the parish turns now toward Lent.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: He says brief, and the glass has already gone over once.
